title: Compute properties for PTO on Si substrate
action: Using the Landau-Devonshire thermodynamic model with strain renormalization, compute the in-plane thermal strain for the Si substrate (isotropic TEC), minimize the free energy to obtain equilibrium polarization P for each growth temperature T_G from 25 to 800 °C, then compute ε33, d33, and tunabilities φ and φ' at E=1000 kV/cm. Write the results to pto_on_si.csv.
description: Results for PTO film on Si substrate: P, ε33, d33, φ, φ' vs T_G.
output_schema: Required columns: TG, P, epsilon33, d33, phi, phi_prime. Data types: float. Units: TG in °C, P in C/m^2, epsilon33 dimensionless, d33 in m/V, phi and phi_prime in %. One row per T_G from 25 to 800 °C.

title: Compute properties for PTO on c-sapphire substrate
action: Using the Landau-Devonshire thermodynamic model, compute the same properties for the c-sapphire substrate (isotropic in-plane TEC). Follow the same procedure as for Si but with the appropriate TEC. Write to pto_on_c_sapphire.csv.
description: Results for PTO film on c-sapphire substrate.
output_schema: Same as pto_on_si.csv: required columns TG, P, epsilon33, d33, phi, phi_prime; same units.

title: Compute properties for PTO on a-sapphire substrate
action: Using the Landau-Devonshire thermodynamic model, compute the same properties for the a-sapphire substrate (anisotropic in-plane TEC). Use the free energy expression with renormalized coefficients appropriate for anisotropic thermal strains. Write to pto_on_a_sapphire.csv.
description: Results for PTO film on a-sapphire substrate.

title: Compute properties for PTO on MgO substrate
action: Using the Landau-Devonshire thermodynamic model, compute the same properties for the MgO substrate (isotropic TEC, compressive thermal strain). Use the free energy expression with renormalized coefficients. Write to pto_on_mgo.csv.
description: Results for PTO film on MgO substrate.
